# Choosing an agent

Use the custom agent that best matches the main task:

- For JavaScript implementation, debugging, or explanation, use [JS Agent](agents/js-agent.agent.md).
- For HTML structure, markup, or accessibility tasks, use [HTML Agent](agents/html-agent.agent.md).
- If a request involves both, choose the agent for the primary task; use the other agent for a clearly separate part when needed.
